directAnswer.en: This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying. It is not a trailer-pump pour. The printed weight is 650 kg and the frame is 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm. Check the doorway before treating it as a small indoor unit. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine at 380 V, 11/15 kW, hydraulic control and all-copper dual motor, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, 150 m horizontal / 70 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, applicable materials cement mortar, concrete and grout, 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm and 650 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine, which prints 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm and 295 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

heading.en: What the indoor spray has to match

body.en: This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying. It is not a trailer-pump pour. The printed weight is 650 kg and the frame is 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm. Check the doorway before treating it as a small indoor unit. The published High-Flow Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine row is 380 V, 11/15 kW, hydraulic control and all-copper dual motor, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, 150 m horizontal / 70 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, applicable materials cement mortar, concrete and grout, 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm and 650 kg.
